entries.title: Job 31:1
segments: I made a covenant with my eyes; how then could I look upon a virgin?

entries.title: Job 31:2
segments: For what [is] the portion from God above? And [what is] the inheritance from the Almighty on high?

entries.title: Job 31:3
segments: [Is] not disaster to the perverse, and calamity to the workers of iniquity?

entries.title: Job 31:4
segments: Does He not see my ways, and count all my steps?

entries.title: Job 31:5
segments: If I have walked with vanity, or if my foot has hurried to deceit,

entries.title: Job 31:6
segments: let me be weighed in an even balance so that God may know my uprightness.

entries.title: Job 31:7
segments: If my step has turned out of the way, or my heart has walked after my eyes, and if any blot has held fast to my hands;

entries.title: Job 31:8
segments: [then] let me sow, and let another eat; and let my harvests be rooted out.

entries.title: Job 31:9
segments: If my heart has been enticed by a woman, or I have laid wait at my neighbor's door,

entries.title: Job 31:10
segments: [then] let my wife grind to another, and let others bow down on her.

entries.title: Job 31:11
segments: For that [would be] an evil purpose; yea, it [would be] an iniquity [to be punished by] the judges.

entries.title: Job 31:12
segments: For it [is] a fire that devours to the Place of Ruin, and it would root out all my gain.

entries.title: Job 31:13
segments: If I despised the cause of my man servant or of my slave-girl, when they argued with me;

entries.title: Job 31:14
segments: what then shall I do when God rises up? And when He calls me to account, what shall I answer Him?

entries.title: Job 31:15
segments: Did not He who made me in the womb make him? And did not One shape us in the womb?

entries.title: Job 31:16
segments: If I have withheld the poor from [their] desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail,

entries.title: Job 31:17
segments: or have eaten my bit alone, and the fatherless has not eaten of it,

entries.title: Job 31:18
segments: for from my youth he grew up with me, as [with] a father, and from my mother's womb I guided her;

entries.title: Job 31:19
segments: if I have seen any perish for lack of clothing, or there was no covering for the needy;

entries.title: Job 31:20
segments: if his loins have not blessed me, and he warmed himself with the fleece of my flock;

entries.title: Job 31:21
segments: if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless when I watched over my help in the gate;

entries.title: Job 31:22
segments: [then] let my arm fall from the shoulder blade, and let my arm be broken from the elbow.

entries.title: Job 31:23
segments: For trouble [from] God [is] a terror to me, and I could not do [anything] because of His highness.

entries.title: Job 31:24
segments: If I have made gold my hope, or have called fine gold my trust;

entries.title: Job 31:25
segments: if I rejoiced because my wealth [was] great, and because my hand had gotten much;

entries.title: Job 31:26
segments: if I looked to the light when it shone, or the moon walking in brightness,

entries.title: Job 31:27
segments: and my heart has been secretly enticed, or my mouth has kissed my hand;

entries.title: Job 31:28
segments: this also [would be] an iniquity [for] the judges; for I would have denied the God above.

entries.title: Job 31:29
segments: If I rejoiced at the ruin of my hater, and I was excited when evil found him;

entries.title: Job 31:30
segments: also I have not allowed my mouth to sin by asking his life with a curse;

entries.title: Job 31:31
segments: if the men of my camp did not say, Who can find one who has not been satisfied with his meat?

entries.title: Job 31:32
segments: The stranger did not sleep in the street, [for] I opened my doors to the traveler.

entries.title: Job 31:33
segments: If I covered my transgressions like Adam, by hiding my iniquity in my bosom,

entries.title: Job 31:34
segments: then let me tremble before a great multitude, and be terrified by the scorn of families; [and] I will be silent [and] not go out the door.

entries.title: Job 31:35
segments: Oh that I had one to hear me! Behold my mark. Let the Almighty answer me, and my Accuser write an indictment.

entries.title: Job 31:36
segments: Surely I would carry it on my shoulder, [and] bind it [like] crowns to me.

entries.title: Job 31:37
segments: I would declare to Him the number of my steps; like a prince I would go near Him.

entries.title: Job 31:38
segments: If my lands cry against me, or its furrows weep together;

entries.title: Job 31:39
segments: if I have eaten its strength without silver, or have caused its owner to expire,

entries.title: Job 31:40
segments: let thorns come forth instead of wheat, and weeds instead of barley. The words of Job are ended.
